review.assessment: The change introduces `percentiles.py` with a `value_at` function that calculates percentile indices using `int(n * p)`. This formula yields an off-by-one error for standard nearest-rank percentiles, as demonstrated by the p95 of 20 samples returning index 19 instead of the required index 18. The implementation must adjust for zero-based indexing to align with the specification and dashboard expectations.
